subject: general
question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of M. Only I sits to the right of O. Only three people sit between O and N. J sits at some place to the left of K but at some place to the right of L. How many people sit between L and K?
solution:
Seven people, I, J, K, L, M, N and O, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only three people sit to the left of M.
 
• Only I sits to the right of O.
 
• Only three people sit between O and N.
 
• J sits at some place to the left of K but at some place to the right of L

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
